plan_intro:
Every day: **algorithms first** (about 50 min, 3 problems from different patterns), then **SQL** (about 20 min), **statistics** (about 20 min) and **AI** (about 20 min), then the **theory flashcards** (10 min). Each day below links its four notebooks: they open in Google Colab straight from GitHub.

Rules that save time and energy: name the pattern before you code; stuck 15 minutes, open Hint 1; stuck 25 minutes, read the solution and re-type it from memory. Keep a short redo list and solve those questions again after 3 and 7 days. Days 1 to 10 are easy, 11 to 20 medium, 21 to 30 hard. Days 7, 14, 21 and 28 are timed mock exams.
